name: AC - Quiz Nightly Data Sync (MySQL → Mautic)

parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.id AS contact_id,
  c.email AS contact_email,
  c.first_name AS contact_first_name,
  c.last_name AS contact_last_name,
  u.id AS coach_user_id,
  u.first_name AS coach_first_name,
  u.last_name AS coach_last_name,
  u.full_name AS coach_full_name,
  u.email AS coach_email,
  u.phone_number AS coach_phone,
  u.area_code AS coach_phone_prefix,
  u.sub_domain AS coach_slug,
  o.org_name AS coach_organisation_name
FROM prod_contacts_activesupport.contacts c
LEFT JOIN prod_activesupport.users u ON u.id = c.coach_id
LEFT JOIN prod_activesupport.organizations o ON o.id = u.organization_id
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (
    c.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
    OR u.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
  )
LIMIT 500

credentialIds.MAUTIC_OAUTH2_CRED_ID: Replace with your Mautic OAuth2 credential ID in n8n

_setupNotes.logic: Nightly at 02:00: Reads recently changed contacts and coach data from explicit production MySQL databases. Finds the matching Mautic contact by ac_contact_id and updates coach name, email, WhatsApp, slug, organisation and sender display fields only when values changed.
_setupNotes.sourceOfTruth: MySQL (Laravel system) is always master. Mautic is the downstream sync target.
_setupNotes.mysqlTableAssumptions: Uses prod_contacts_activesupport.contacts joined to prod_activesupport.users via contacts.coach_id and prod_activesupport.organizations via users.organization_id.
_setupNotes.scalingNote: For >500 contacts with recent changes, add pagination or increase limit
